description_full: Farmland Partners Inc. is an internally managed real estate company that owns and seeks to acquire high-quality North American farmland and makes loans to third-party farmers (both tenant and non-tenant) and landowners secured by farm real estate and/or other agricultural related assets. As of September 30, 2026, the Company owned approximately 70,000 acres of farmland in 11 states, including Arkansas, California, Colorado, Illinois, Indiana, Louisiana, Missouri, Nebraska, South Carolina, Texas and West Virginia. In addition, the Company owns land and buildings for four agriculture equipment dealerships in Ohio leased to Ag Pro under the John Deere brand. The Company elected to be taxed as a real estate investment trust, or REIT, for U.S. federal income tax purposes, commencing with the taxable year ended December 31, 2014. Farmland Partners Inc. was established on September 27, 2013, and is based in Denver, United States.

financial_summary: Farmland Partners Inc. is a small-cap real estate business with a $380M market cap on $52M of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at -5% over the past three years and +14% annually across the full decade, and a shrinking top line is the hardest headwind any business can overcome.
Returns on capital run at 6% against a 7% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests.
On the balance sheet, debt is moderate at 3.5× net debt/EBITDA, serviceable in normal conditions but worth watching through a downturn, and interest coverage runs at 4.3×.

Management returns a meaningful 26.7% of market cap to owners through dividends and buybacks, a strong signal of disciplined capital allocation, and insiders hold 8.2% of the shares, and within its sector the business captures 4.0× its fair share of profits, a structural advantage visible in the numbers.
